title: ROIEdgeFit mode params
description: Slides the calibrated ROI polygon template over the image and finds the position where its boundary best aligns with detected edge pixels, using FFT cross-correlation followed by fine-grid refinement.

roi_expansion_px.description: Search budget. ROI2 = calibrated ROI1 expanded by this many pixels on every side. The matching template (ROI1) is allowed to slide anywhere within ROI2 to find the best fit; the output polygon is always ROI1's size, just translated to the best position. If 0, no movement is allowed and the result equals ROI1.

use_ab.description: True = use A:B accumulated difference frames for edge detection; False = single frame.

blur_method.description: Blur method applied before gradient computation.

blur_kernel.description: Gaussian blur kernel size (must be odd). Only used when blur_method = 'gaussian'.

bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral filter sigma in color space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral filter sigma in coordinate space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

scoring_signal.description:
Signal used for ROI template matching.

'edge_map' — Sobel gradient is thresholded to a binary (black/white) edge map. Best when you want crisp edge alignment.

'gradient_magnitude' — continuous Sobel magnitude (no threshold). Softer signal that rewards proximity to strong edges.

'raw_intensity' — blurred grayscale pixel values used directly; no Sobel at all. Useful when the tip boundary is defined by brightness contrast rather than gradient features.

gradient_ksize.description: Sobel kernel size for gradient computation (3, 5, or 7).

gradient_threshold.description: Minimum gradient magnitude to treat a pixel as an edge candidate for the binary edge map.

edge_outward_offset_px.description: Contract the matching template inward by this many pixels before fitting, then report the output polygon at its original size. Compensates for the systematic inward bias of Sobel-based edge detection (detected edges land slightly inside the true tip boundary). Positive values contract the template (typical use); negative values expand it.

n_coarse_peaks.description: Number of top-scoring coarse FFT positions to refine with the fine-grid search.

refine_range_px.description: Radius in pixels for the fine-grid search around each coarse FFT peak.

refine_step_px.description: Step size in pixels for the fine-grid refinement search.

score_falloff_type.description:
Falloff function for the boundary alignment score.
• 'gaussian'  w = exp(−d² / (2·σ²))
• 'inverse'   w = σ / (σ + d)  — a 1/x-like curve with a longer tail

score_falloff_px.description: Controls the width of the falloff curve. For 'gaussian' this is σ (standard deviation). For 'inverse' this is the half-value distance — the distance at which the score contribution is halved.

score_cutoff_px.description: Edge pixels further than this distance from the ROI boundary contribute a score of zero and are skipped entirely. Reduces computation time for points far from the boundary. Set to 0 to disable (all distances are scored, weighted by the falloff function).

min_confidence.description: Minimum normalised score (0–1) for the fitted position to be accepted as a candidate.

max_candidates.description: Maximum number of candidates to pass downstream (currently ROIEdgeFit always produces at most 1).

use_edge_detection.description: When true, the fitting signal is a sparse map of N-of-M confirmed edge points produced by the InwardEdgeScan detector, rather than the raw Sobel threshold map. This gives cleaner, noise-filtered inputs for the ROI fit. All parameters in this group are only active when this is enabled.

confirmation_n.description: N in N-of-M confirmation: minimum number of consecutive edge candidates required to accept a point.

confirmation_m.description: M in N-of-M confirmation: window size (rows) over which N confirmations must occur.

intensity_delta.description: Minimum intensity difference between inside and outside the tip edge for confirmation.

intensity_avg_pixels.description: Number of pixels averaged on each side of the edge for intensity delta calculation.

confirmation_brightness_threshold.description: Minimum pixel brightness required inside the tip region to confirm an edge point.

edge_detection_offset.description: Inward offset (px) from the ROI boundary before starting the inward edge scan.

min_edge_length_enabled.description: Enable the minimum contiguous edge length filter.

min_edge_length.description: Minimum number of contiguous edge points required to keep an edge segment.

consistency_check_enabled.description: Enable the consistency check that removes points deviating from the local edge trend.

consistency_window.description: Half-window size (rows) used when computing the local trend for the consistency check.

consistency_sigma.description: Sigma multiplier for the consistency check deviation threshold.

outlier_removal_enabled.description: Enable the outlier removal pass that drops points far from the fitted edge line.

outlier_threshold.description: Z-score threshold above which an edge point is considered an outlier and removed.

detect_left.description: Scan for the left edge of the tip.

detect_right.description: Scan for the right edge of the tip.

detect_bottom.description: Scan for the bottom edge of the tip.

section_offset.description: Vertical overlap (px) added at the boundary between adjacent ROI sections.

bottom_search_depth.description: Number of rows to search upward from the ROI bottom when detecting the tip bottom edge.

bottom_scan_half_width.description: Half-width (px) of the horizontal scan window used for bottom edge detection.

use_contrast.description: When true, a per-pixel difference between the sample frame and a reference frame (e.g. tip without liquid) is computed before all other processing. The reference source is set in the A/B Compare dialog or via ImageSet.reference_frames. The contrast image replaces the normal working frame.

contrast_mode.description:
'absolute' — output = |sample − reference|. Values below contrast_min → 0; at or above contrast_max → 255; in between linearly scaled to 0–255.

'relative' — signed difference centred at grey (127). sample brighter → > 127; reference brighter → < 127. |diff| < contrast_min → 127 (neutral); |diff| ≥ contrast_max → 0 or 255.

contrast_blur_method.description: Blur applied independently to both sample and reference before computing the difference. Independent of any other blur step in the pipeline.

contrast_blur_kernel.description: Gaussian kernel size for the contrast pre-blur (must be odd). Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'gaussian'.

contrast_bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral sigma colour for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral sigma space for the contrast pre-blur. Only used when contrast_blur_method = 'bilateral'.

contrast_min.description: Minimum contrast threshold (0–255). Differences smaller than this are suppressed: 0 in absolute mode, 127 (neutral grey) in relative mode. Filters noise and background flicker.

contrast_max.description: Maximum contrast cap (0–255). Differences at or above this are fully saturated. Values between contrast_min and contrast_max are linearly stretched to 0–255. Must be greater than contrast_min.
